library.fileReplayUploadLimitHintGeneric: Upload size is limited. If you get 413, use a smaller file or raise limits on the hub and reverse proxy (e.g. nginx client_max_body_size).
library.fileReplayUpload413: 413: request body too large. Hub config currently allows about {{max}} MiB per upload (video.file_test_max_upload_mb). If your file is clearly smaller, the reverse proxy (e.g. nginx client_max_body_size) is usually the limit.
library.fileReplayUpload413Proxy: 413: response looks like a proxy block (nginx, etc.), not hub JSON — raise client_max_body_size on the location that serves /api/ (often must be ≥ your file size). Status currently shows about {{max}} MiB from YAML; the real cut-off can be lower if the proxy rejects first.
library.fileReplayUpload413Generic: Request body too large (HTTP 413). Try a smaller file or raise upload limits on the reverse proxy and hub.

library.datasetFlowIntro: Typical path: import recordings → regenerate tracks if needed → export dataset. Spectrograms are not required for crops or training; use them only if you rely on the BirdNET-over-MQTT flow and want updated spectrogram images. Retro-export and clean-dataset are optional maintenance, not part of the minimal loop.
library.datasetFlowStep1: Import: "Scan and import" picks up new files under the recordings archive.
library.datasetFlowStep2: Period and filters: set the date range above; for tracks you can limit species so only videos that already have those detections are queued.
library.datasetFlowStep3: Tracks: "Regenerate tracks" when detections/bboxes in the DB must be rebuilt (after setting changes or bad frames). Large archives: run overnight and slice by period.
library.datasetFlowStep4: Crops on disk: use "Retro-export" from saved detections if needed, then "Export dataset" (ZIP). "Clean dataset" only when you intentionally remove bad or orphaned files under train/.

library.datasetExportCompositionHint: The ZIP is built from files under data/dataset/train/ (and val when splitting): class names come from folder names, not from the full species catalog. The date range filters crops by each video’s recording date; the default “last 7 days” preset often yields a subset — widen the range or use “All time”. “Manually corrected only”, train-ready, and minimum images per class also change membership. Leftover folders after renaming a species can appear as extra classes; use dataset cleanup if needed.
library.maintenanceMovedToSystem: Archive, dataset, and database operations are grouped on the Library page so the operator workflow stays consistent.

settings.accordionMotionDesc: Any enabled trigger starts the same clip session: frames are captured from the camera, the detector (YOLO) runs on them, and results land in the visit record; the video file is part of that session—not “recording only”. Default trigger is camera motion (OpenCV). External MQTT object events, standalone MQTT/ESPHome sensors, and weight spikes (if enabled) can run in parallel. OpenCV can remain enabled as a safety net. BirdNET contributes to audio merge and notification thresholds, not session start.

settings.streamNameHint: Primary stream used for clip recording. This name is shown in Live.
settings.detectStreamNameHint: Optional: separate stream for motion, YOLO, and preview — usually lower resolution/FPS. Can be a direct low-res camera stream or another relay stream name. Empty = same stream as recording.
settings.mqttBrokerHint: IP or domain of broker (sensors, external events, automations)
settings.frigateTopicHint: Object events used for merging with YOLO
settings.frigateTopicConnectionsHint: Subscription topic for object events (e.g. Frigate). Thresholds, allow/block lists, and exclusions: Capture & feeder → External MQTT detector.
settings.frigateMotionIntro: When enabled, matching MQTT events start the same clip session as OpenCV. Configure the broker and topic above under Connections → MQTT.
settings.frigateMinTriggerScore: Minimum MQTT event score to start a clip
settings.frigateMinTriggerScoreHint: Events below this score are ignored for starting a recording. Use 0 to disable the threshold. Typical values are between 0.3 and 0.7.
settings.frigateRoutingDesc: Camera IDs must match Video → Cameras. Empty camera list = all configured cameras. Empty allowed-label list = any label (noisier).
settings.frigateCameraFilterHint: Comma-separated. Empty = same IDs as in Video → Cameras (not every camera on the MQTT broker).
settings.frigateLabelFilterHint: Start recording only when MQTT label matches (case-insensitive). Empty = any label (noisier).
settings.frigateExclusionsIntro: Three layers — from softest to strictest. Use step 1 for pets/noise, step 2 to block clip start, step 3 to drop MQTT-only rows from the feed.
settings.frigateExclusionTier1Desc: Clip may still start (OpenCV or geometry). Species merge and Telegram are skipped; review-only in DB when standalone is on.
settings.frigateExclusionTier2Title: Hard block — no clip start via geometry
settings.frigateExclusionTier2Desc: Even if MQTT sends a tracked box, do not start a session for these labels.
settings.frigateExclusionTier3Desc: After the clip: no standalone or trigger-salvage row for these labels. Birds are unaffected.
settings.frigateGeometryDesc: Start a clip when MQTT has coordinates but the label failed the allowed list. Pair with step 2 to block people and vehicles.
settings.frigateLabelExcludeHint: Labels like cat/dog: ignored for species merge and Telegram; clip may still start (geometry fallback or OpenCV). Stored as review-only when standalone is on.
settings.frigateGeometryFallbackExcludeHint: When label is not in the allowed list but MQTT has a tracked box, geometry fallback can still start recording — unless the label is listed here.
settings.frigateStandaloneSkipLabelsHint: After the clip: no standalone or trigger-salvage row in the feed for these labels (people, cars, …). Birds are unaffected.
settings.frigateGeometryFallbackEnabled: Geometry fallback (start clip on tracked box)
settings.frigateGeometryFallbackEnabledHint: If the label fails the allowed list but MQTT payload has coordinates, still start recording. Use exclusions above to block people/cars.
settings.frigateTriggerOnGeometry: Allow geometry fallback when label not in allowed list
settings.frigateTriggerOnGeometryHint: If MQTT payload has coordinates but the label fails the filter, still start a clip session (source already tracks an object).
settings.frigateFusionDesc: Post-track thresholds, merge windows, and MQTT-only fallback when YOLO produced no track (e.g. light gate on). “Unknown” usually means an unmapped source label — add **detection.species_mapping** (source label → Rodent / species). Restart processor after changes.
settings.detectionMinConfidenceToStore: Min confidence to keep after merge
settings.detectionMinConfidenceToStoreHint: Detections below are dropped at finalize (0–1). Keep aligned with classifier threshold.
settings.detectionMergeWindowHint: How wide MQTT events are tied to clip time.
settings.detectionDedupWindowHint: Gap after which same species counts as a new visit.
settings.detectionOnePerSpecies: One result per species per clip
settings.detectionOnePerSpeciesHint: Collapse multiple rows of the same species into one.
settings.detectionCrossSourceBonus: Confidence bonus on first MQTT merge
settings.detectionCrossSourceBonusHint: One-time add when a YOLO row first merges with an MQTT event in-window (capped at 1.0).
settings.learnedFusionIntro: Optional: after the usual rule-based merge, blend a small scorer (detector, classifier, BirdNET hints, key-frame signals) into the final confidence. The toggle and alpha only change **runtime** behaviour if the model file is reachable by the processor. Shipping a new model is an **admin** job (System → fusion export / train on the hub), not something you configure by guessing server paths here. Manual species fixes on a recording fix what you see in the database and UI; they **do not** by themselves install a new fusion model or run overnight training.
settings.learnedFusionEnableHint: If the model file fails to load, a built-in heuristic scorer is used instead (check fusion trace / logs).
settings.learnedFusionModelPathHint: Usually leave the hub default. Change only if support gave you a different model file name to enter (no need to hunt paths on the server).
settings.learnedFusionAlphaHint: final = alpha × learned + (1 − alpha) × rule-based confidence. Try 0.3–0.6; lower is more conservative.
settings.recognitionImprovementIntro: When enabled, the hub uses built-in confidence improvement and can switch to a trained model after enough manual fixes are collected. File paths and maintenance actions are kept out of the main user flow.
settings.recognitionImprovementEnableHint: Turn this off if you want the hub to rely only on the base rule set.
settings.recognitionImprovementSensitivityHint: How strongly the extra improvement influences final confidence. Lower is more conservative.
settings.frigateStandaloneHeading: Fallback: MQTT visit without YOLO track
settings.frigateStandaloneWhenNoYolo: Create visit if YOLO had no track but external MQTT source sent an event
settings.frigateStandaloneWhenNoYoloHint: Otherwise such clips are often deleted as zero detections. Tune thresholds below or disable notify to limit noise.
settings.frigateStandaloneWhenNoAcceptedSpecies: Replace lone YOLO generic Bird with species from MQTT event
settings.frigateStandaloneWhenNoAcceptedSpeciesHi: When enabled and YOLO yields exactly one accepted_generic Bird row, an event can replace it with mapped species. Multiple YOLO tracks: unchanged.
settings.frigateStandaloneMinScoreHint: Lower = more clips saved, higher false positives. 0 not recommended.
settings.frigateStandaloneMissingFallbackHint: 0 = off. Use for snapshots/payloads without top_score.
settings.frigateStandaloneNotifyHint: Off = save to DB without chat photo (like excluded labels). Global min_confidence_to_notify still applies.
settings.frigateStandaloneExcludedIntro: Visit is stored with source label (e.g. Cat) without Telegram and without YOLO species merge — for manual relabeling.
settings.frigateStandaloneExcludedCaptureHint: Block lists for pets/people/cars — Capture & feeder → External MQTT detector → Block lists.
settings.frigateStandaloneExcludedMinScoreHint: Usually 0 — accept with imputation below when score is missing.
settings.frigateStandaloneExcludedMissingFallback: e.g. 0.58 when source payload omits top_score.
settings.absorbGenericBird: Collapse generic Bird with confident species
settings.absorbGenericBirdHint: If the same clip has a specific species above classifier threshold — single result.
settings.absorbGenericBirdOverlapHint: How much Bird and species intervals must overlap.
settings.absorbGenericBirdMinClassifierHint: Below this, Bird is not absorbed into that species.
settings.mqttPublishTopicHint: Where Hub publishes merged detections (for HA automations and integrations)
settings.mqttReconnectMinDelayHint: Minimum delay before reconnect after disconnect
settings.mqttHaDiscoveryHint: Publish configs so HA auto-discovers Last Species, Bird at Feeder, etc.
settings.birdnetUrlHint: URL to BirdNET-Pi/Go. Empty — icon hidden.
settings.heimdallUrlHint: Heimdall URL used for a reachability probe from the Hub server (System page). For Docker, use a hostname resolvable from the Hub container.
settings.donateUrlHint: URL opened by the heart icon in the top bar.
settings.accordionPerformanceDesc: Redis TTL cache for heavy API responses. In Docker, Redis runs by default; you can turn it off or set a custom URL.
settings.performanceRedisEnabledHint: Off — in-process memory only (ignores REDIS_URL from the environment).
settings.performanceRedisUrlHint: Empty — REDIS_URL from the environment is used. If set, overrides the environment. Saved passwords are masked in the API.
settings.encodingHint: Intel — VA-API on any Intel integrated GPU. Requires /dev/dri/renderD128 in container.
settings.recordWithVaapiHint: Off uses libx264 for the MP4 file only — more stable on some iGPUs (broken moov / encode error 24). Live capture can still use VA-API when Capture backend is Auto. Inference (OpenVINO) is unchanged.
settings.recordStreamCodecCopy: Copy from stream (fast, may be HEVC)
settings.recordStreamCodecHint: H.264 re-encodes on CPU when encoding is «cpu»; Intel GPU path already outputs H.264. New recordings only — old clips keep their codec.
settings.captureBackendHint: Auto keeps OpenCV on CPU mode and tries FFmpeg VA-API for motion/detection frames when recording encoding is Intel and /dev/dri works.
settings.videoPreRecordSecondsHint: Adds this many seconds before trigger time to each clip when available. 0 disables pre-roll.
settings.videoAutoReconnectHint: When enabled, the processor retries stream connection after transport errors.
settings.videoFileReplayDesc: Used when the hub runs in file replay mode (see Library). Test file path is set in Library or YAML, not here.
settings.videoFileRealtimeSimulationHint: On: skip frames to match wall clock. Off: process frame-by-frame (slower, easier debugging).
settings.videoFileReplayLibraryHint: Switching live vs file mode and playlist folder are in
settings.videoFileModeActiveHint: Processor is in disk replay mode. Cameras below are not used until you return to live in
settings.videoFilePathHint: Absolute path inside container, e.g. /app/data/file_test/clip.mp4 (default compose mounts host ./data to /app/data)
settings.videoFileDirHint: If file path is empty: all *.mp4/*.mov/*.mkv directly in this folder (not subfolders), sorted. In Docker use a path under /app/data/… (e.g. /app/data/file_test). Restart from the first file only if “Loop playback” is enabled.
settings.videoFileLoopHint: On — playback restarts after end of file.
settings.triggerHint: Pick one recording trigger. External MQTT trigger works only when MQTT events are actually arriving.
settings.triggerGroupedHint: You can enable any combination of triggers; any source that fires starts the same capture-and-detection session. Each block is configured below.
settings.speciesCatalogDesc: Strict ingest and optional tuning targets; allowlist file path stays in YAML.
settings.speciesCatalogStrictIngestHint: When on, species outside the allowlist are rejected at ingest.
settings.speciesTuningTargetIdsHint: Comma- or space-separated numeric species IDs for tuning pipelines.
settings.triggerScales: Start a session on weight spike
settings.triggerScalesHint: Optional: when weight delta exceeds the threshold, the hub starts the same clip session as for motion. Scale wiring, topics, and mass estimation live in “Feeder scales” above—even if this trigger is off.
settings.triggerScalesPipelineHint: Same pipeline as other triggers: camera frames, per-frame detection, visit includes weight when scale data is available.
settings.opencvMasksLiveHint: OpenCV trigger exclusion masks are per camera in Live view (fullscreen editor). They do not affect YOLO.
settings.yoloDetectionZonesDesc: Global polygons to filter YOLO detections after a session starts: ignore inside mask and/or interest zones. Format: [[[x,y],...], ...], coordinates 0..1.
settings.yoloIgnoreMasksHint: Detection center inside polygon is rejected.
settings.yoloInterestZonesHint: Optional: keep detections only inside zones.
settings.motionCheckEveryNFramesHint: OpenCV only: 1 = every frame, 3 = every 3rd. Reduces CPU load at high FPS.
settings.mqttSensorAlert: MQTT sensor: subscribe to topic. On ON/1 — start a clip session (camera capture + detector). Tasmota: stat/NAME/STATE or stat/NAME/PIR.
settings.mqttTopicHint: Topic where ON is published on motion
settings.esphomeAlert: ESPHome: binary sensor (PIR, door). On state change — same clip session as other triggers. Requires web_server in ESPHome config.
settings.sensorIdHint: id from YAML: binary_sensor: - id: bird_pir
settings.feedMqttHint: MQTT broker — in Connection section. Below only relay topic.
settings.esphomeFeedHint: IP and name from ESPHome config. Switch — relay (turn_on/turn_off). Button — button (press, duration on device). Important: ESPHome YAML must have web_server:, otherwise REST API (404) won't work.
settings.switchIdHint: ID from YAML: switch: - id: bird_feeder. Must match object_id.
settings.webhookUrlHint: POST on each detection (IFTTT, Zapier). JSON: species, confidence, time, source
settings.galleryEnabled: Upload best frames to community site (opt-in)
settings.galleryUploadUrlHint: multipart/form-data: image, species, confidence, timestamp, latitude, longitude
settings.webPushDesc: Browser push notifications for detections (alternative or addition to Telegram).
settings.telegramChatIdHint: e.g. -1001234567890. Add bot as channel admin.
settings.refreshTelegramProxyHint: Find a working Telegram SOCKS5 proxy and save it into settings.
settings.telegramProxyTypeHint: No keys from my.telegram.org? Use «SOCKS5 / HTTP» or «No proxy» — api_id not required. MTProto only if you have api_id+api_hash from Telegram’s site.
settings.telegramProxyUrlHint: For «SOCKS/HTTP»: e.g. socks5h://127.0.0.1:9050 or http://127.0.0.1:8118 — tunnel to api.telegram.org.
settings.telegramMtprotoSecretHint: Hex string from the Telegram app (often starts with ee or dd). Masked in the API.
settings.telegramMtprotoApiHint: MTProto needs api_id and api_hash from https://my.telegram.org → API development tools (or TELEGRAM_API_ID / TELEGRAM_API_HASH in the container .env). If the Telegram site shows an error: try VPN, another browser, mobile data, or later — my.telegram.org is often flaky from some networks.
settings.telegramApiIdHint: Integer from my.telegram.org (not the bot token).
settings.telegramApiHashHint: String from my.telegram.org; masked in the API.
settings.telegramApiBaseHint: Empty — https://api.telegram.org. Alternative: reverse proxy that forwards to Telegram.
settings.telegramTimeoutHint: 30–600. Higher values help on slow or blocked networks. Text messages use half this value.
settings.telegramRetriesHint: 1–5 attempts on timeout or connection errors.
settings.telegramMaxSidePxHint: 0 — do not resize. Downscales large crops before send.
settings.telegramThreadIdHint: Empty — no topics. For forum channel — topic ID.
settings.paidMediaForwardStarsHint: When view free: 0 — allow, >0 — block. When view paid — forward included.
settings.weatherHint: Weather: Overview, Timeline, video details. Saved with each recording. Coordinates — below.
settings.postRecordSecondsHint: Added to «seconds without activity» before stopping the clip. 0 = off.
settings.processorMultiCameraBirdnetDesc: Camera IDs in one line = one location. BirdNET bias lowers classifier threshold for species recently heard on MQTT.
settings.multiCameraGroups: Cameras at the same location (camera IDs)
settings.multiCameraGroupsHint: One group per line; cameras comma-separated (must match IDs in Video → Cameras). Empty = disabled.
settings.multiCameraConfidenceBoostHint: Added to merged confidence when the same species appears on two or more cameras in one group (0–0.5).
settings.processorAdaptiveProfilesDesc: When enabled, the processor applies softer thresholds on dark or low-contrast frames (brightness/contrast gates). Overrides apply only while the night profile is active.
settings.processorAdaptiveProfilesEnabledHint: Requires processor restart to take effect everywhere.
settings.processorNightMaxBrightnessHint: If measured brightness is at or below this value, the night profile may activate (see contrast below).
settings.processorNightMaxContrastHint: If measured contrast is at or below this value, the night profile may activate (OR with brightness).
settings.processorNightOverridesIntro: While the night profile is active, these values temporarily replace the base processor settings below.
settings.processorOverrideLightGateBrightnessHint: Lower than base gate so YOLO can run in twilight/IR.
settings.processorOverrideLightGateContrastHint: Lower than base gate for flat night scenes.
settings.processorOverrideMinConfidenceBinaryHint: Softer shared detection-head threshold (`min_confidence_binary`) during night profile.
settings.processorOverrideMinConfidenceBinaryBird: Bird label only; engine uses min with rodent threshold.
settings.processorOverrideMinConfidenceBinaryRode: Rodent-class threshold while the night profile is active (same semantics as main Processor → Rodent).
settings.processorOverrideMinTrackDurationHint: Shorter tracks discarded by ByteTrack during night profile.
settings.processorOverrideMinConfidenceToProcessH: Combined classifier threshold while night profile is active.
settings.processorOverrideMinBoxSizePxHint: Smaller boxes allowed during night profile.
settings.processorOverrideMinCenterDist: Override: min center distance from edge
settings.processorOverrideMinCenterDistHint: Normalized 0–1; lower keeps birds near frame edges.
settings.processorOverrideMaxClassificationsPerFr: Round-robin / priority budget for species classifier per frame.
settings.processorDetectorPipelineDesc: YOLO input size, live downscale, blur gate, classification scheduling, and slow-detect warning threshold.
settings.processorBinaryImgszHint: Must match model IR export (`processor.binary_imgsz`, often **704** on production). Larger = heavier CPU/GPU.
settings.processorInferenceLoresPx: Live inference lores width (px, legacy square)
settings.processorInferenceLoresPxHint: Used when inference_lores_wh is unset. Keep aligned with detect substream.
settings.processorStreamGeometryDesc: Detect substream size and FPS fallback when probe/RTSP returns nothing. See video.detect_fps under Capture.
settings.processorDetectUseNativeResolutionHint: When true, letterbox runs inside the detector only.
settings.processorInferenceLoresWhHint: Typically 704×576 for Go2RTC substream. Overrides inference_lores_px.
settings.processorDetectionQualityAssumedFpsHint: Used when probe and video.detect_fps=0 do not yield FPS.
settings.processorOpenvinoBirdScoreScaleHint: 1.0 = no inflation; higher values increase false positives on OpenVINO.
settings.processorMog2Desc: Reject boxes that sit on learned static feeder background.
settings.processorMog2MinFgRatioHint: Below this — treat as static background.
settings.processorTrackRegenLoresWhHint: Overrides track_regen_lores_px; usually matches live detect.
settings.videoDetectFpsHint: 0 uses stream probe. Explicit value overrides probe.
settings.processorFrameProcessingWarnMsHint: If one detect() call exceeds this, a warning metric is recorded.
settings.processorMaxClassificationsPerFrameHint: Caps species classifier calls per frame after blur filtering.
settings.processorMaxBlurChecksHint: How many candidate crops are checked for blur before classifying.
settings.processorBlurThresholdHint: Higher variance = sharper; below threshold crop is treated as blurry.
settings.processorMinCenterDist: Min bbox center distance from frame edge
settings.processorMinCenterDistHint: Normalized 0–1; rejects detections too close to borders.
settings.processorBirdnetExtendedDesc: Rolling audio prior window, FIFO snapshot for System diagnostics, and MQTT log verbosity.
settings.processorBirdnetPriorWindowHoursHint: BirdNET events contribute within this rolling window.
settings.processorBirdnetPriorTtlHoursHint: Events older than TTL are evicted from the prior store.
settings.processorBirdnetPriorHalfLifeHoursHint: Time decay for stale audio evidence.
settings.processorBirdnetPriorMinConfidenceHint: Ignore weaker MQTT events when building the prior.
settings.processorBirdnetBiasWindowSecondsHint: Deprecated alias; 0 uses hour-based prior. Some old configs still set seconds.
settings.processorBirdnetFifoSnapshotEnabled: Write BirdNET FIFO snapshot to disk
settings.processorBirdnetFifoSnapshotIntervalSecH: How often the processor flushes FIFO JSON for the hub UI.
settings.processorBirdnetFifoSnapshotRecentLimitH: Max recent rows kept in the snapshot file.
settings.processorBirdnetFifoSnapshotStaleSecHint: UI treats snapshot older than this as stale.
settings.processorBirdnetFifoHearingActiveHoursHi: UI marks species as recently heard if newer than this.
settings.processorBirdnetFifoPersistEnabled: Persist BirdNET FIFO queue in SQLite
settings.processorBirdnetFifoSqliteBusyMsHint: Increase if you see database locked under load.
settings.processorBirdnetObservabilityDebug: Also emit debug logs at info level
settings.processorBirdnetObservabilityDebugHint: Emergency verbosity without switching level to debug.
settings.processorBehaviorDesc: Optional logistic baseline on recording finalize (#416). Requires a valid behavior_logistic_export JSON on disk; processor restart picks up config changes.
settings.processorBehaviorBundledWeights: The shipped image includes a demo weights file at models/behavior/behavior_logistic_export@v1.json (trained on synthetic data — not your cameras). Default config points there; check the path field below after upgrades.
settings.processorBehaviorNoDatasetUi: Разметка — на странице каждого ролика (поле поведения). Переобучить веса по накопленным меткам может администратор: раздел «Система», карточка ниже. Для офлайн-пайплайна по CSV и Makefile см. README репозитория.
settings.processorBehaviorEnabledHint: When on, the processor may set behavior_label on new videos if weights_path resolves and detections exist.
settings.processorBehaviorWeightsPathHint: Relative to the processor package root or absolute path, e.g. models/detection/weights/behavior_logistic_export@v1.json. Leave empty to disable inference even if the toggle is on.
settings.processorBehaviorStoreMinHint: 0–1. Below this probability the label is not written to the video row.
settings.processorBehaviorReviewThresholdHint: 0–1. If stored confidence is below this value, the first detection may be flagged for review (behavior_uncertainty).
settings.processorBehaviorInferenceBackendHint: auto: use ONNX/IR when processor.models.behavior_openvino is set (labels from weights_path), otherwise logistic JSON. OpenVINO device follows classifier inference device / BIRDLENSE_CLASSIFIER_INFERENCE_DEVICE.
settings.processorBehaviorOpenvinoFallback: On OpenVINO failure fall back to logistic JSON
settings.processorBehaviorOpenvinoFallbackHint: When off, IR load/inference failures skip filling behavior from the same weights_path logistic export.
settings.processorBehaviorMaxRuntimeDetsHint: How many detections contribute to runtime proxy features at finalize (1–500).
settings.processorModelsScopeDesc: Keep everyday recognition behaviour here: regional species, generic Bird tuning, and recording behaviour. Model file management and maintenance live in service mode.
settings.processorModelsCatalogDiagnosticsLink: Compare model classes vs catalog and dataset folders: <syslink>System → Catalog → Catalog diagnostics</syslink> (advanced mode turns on when you follow this link).
settings.processorModelsSupportLink: Weight uploads, fingerprints, and maintenance actions now live in <syslink>System → Service mode</syslink>.
settings.processorWeightsIntroInline: File status for the paths above: built-in image assets or copies after upload. Upload/reset updates user_config and requests a processor restart.
settings.processorInferenceBackendHint: Auto prefers OpenVINO when IR path and runtime are available, otherwise falls back to Torch. OpenVINO uses processor.models.binary_openvino or BIRDLENSE_BINARY_OPENVINO_PATH. ONNX Runtime stays YAML-only until implemented.
settings.processorClassifierInferenceBackendHint: Separate backend for species classifier. Auto prefers OpenVINO classifier IR when available, otherwise uses Torch checkpoint.
settings.processorInferenceDeviceHint: Optional device override (e.g. intel:gpu for OpenVINO). Leave empty for automatic selection; BIRDLENSE_INFERENCE_DEVICE in .env wins at runtime.
settings.processorClassifierInferenceDeviceHint: Optional classifier device override. Leave empty to follow the detector/BIRDLENSE_CLASSIFIER_INFERENCE_DEVICE.
settings.processorDetectorWeightContractHint: Checks model class names against detector_scope; enforce fails fast on mismatch.
settings.processorModelBinaryOpenvinoPathHint: Directory or .xml export from YOLO/OpenVINO. Leave empty unless inference backend is OpenVINO.
settings.processorModelClassifierOpenvinoPathHint: Directory or .xml export from YOLO/OpenVINO for species classifier. Used when classifier backend is OpenVINO/Auto.
settings.processorDetectionStrategyTwoStageDesc: This Hub uses detection head → species classifier (two_stage); the shipped default is BRG (Bird / Rodent / Background).
settings.processorSingleStageWarning: Your config still uses a non-standard strategy. Switch to two_stage here and save settings.
settings.processorModelBinaryPathHint: Relative to the processor working directory. best.pt is the usual Ultralytics checkpoint filename; the shipped default head classifies Bird / Rodent / Background—not only bird vs background.
settings.processorModelClassifierPathHint: Relative to the processor root. Shipped path: models/classification/weights/best.pt (EU ~491 species, Hugging Face gfermoto/birdlense-birds-eu). For a custom .pt, put it under models/classification/weights and set the path; keep class_names.txt aligned with the model. NABirds: see best_US.pt in docs.
settings.processorRegionalSpeciesHint: Empty = all classifier classes. Non-empty narrows YOLO/classifier scope.
settings.processorSaveImagesHint: Writes extra images under data; can grow disk usage.
settings.processorClassifierEntropyGeHint: Empty disables entropy rule. Higher entropy marks uncertain classifier outputs for decision_trace and AL.
settings.processorClassifierMarginLeHint: Empty disables margin rule. Low margin marks close species calls for review.
settings.processorGenericBirdMinDetectorConfHint: Bird detector confidence floor for generic Bird rows.
settings.processorGenericBirdMinFramesHint: Minimum supporting frames before accepting generic Bird.
settings.processorGenericBirdMinAreaFrac: Generic Bird: min bbox area (fraction of frame)
settings.processorGenericBirdMinBestFrameScoreHin: Quality score on best_frame before promoting generic Bird.
settings.processorKeyFrameLimitHint: Max keyframes saved per species for dataset export.
settings.processorKeepRecordingWhenNoDetections: Keep session folder when no detections (file mode)
settings.processorKeepRecordingWhenNoDetectionsHi: For video.source=file testing: retain mp4 even with zero YOLO tracks.
settings.processorTrackRegenDesc: Used when re-running detection on library videos. Separate from live inference.
settings.processorTrackRegenFrameStepHint: 1 = every decoded frame; 6+ skips frames for speed.
settings.processorTrackRegenDetectionStrategyHint: Must be two_stage with current stack.
settings.processorTrackRegenLoresPxHint: Should be ≥ inference_lores_px for parity with live.
settings.processorTrackRegenVideoTimeoutSecHint: Abort stuck videos in batch regen.
settings.processorTrackRegenPreciseTimeoutSecHint: Second pass with relaxed center distance.
settings.processorTrackRegenPreciseDetectionStrat: Usually same as main regen strategy.
settings.processorTrackRegenPreciseMinCenterDistH: Allows birds closer to edges on fallback pass.
settings.processorTrackRegenIgnoreRegionalSpecies: When true, classifier uses full label set during batch regen.
settings.processorTrackRegenMatchLivePipelineHint: Aligns archive regen with live capture parameters.
settings.processorTrackRegenParallelAutoWithManua: Regen: keep auto rows overlapping manual corrections
Allows parallel VideoSpecies when manual edits overlap auto timeline.
settings.processorTrackRegenIouIdFallback: Regen: IoU stitch when ByteTrack has no box ids
settings.processorTrackRegenIouIdFallbackHint: Offline regen: if Ultralytics yields boxes without track ids, stitch frames by overlapping boxes (IoU).
settings.processorTrackRegenIouMatchThresholdHint: Minimum IoU to treat two boxes as the same track across frames (default 0.22; lower is more forgiving).
settings.minSecondsBetweenRecordingsHint: Cooldown after a clip ends before starting another (reduces near-duplicate clips).
settings.fileMaxRecordFloorSecondsHint: Lower bound for max_record_seconds when playing file playlists.
settings.frigateActivityHoldSecondsHint: Keeps session alive briefly after last YOLO hit if the external source still reports activity.
settings.birdnetMqttAutoConfidence: Lower classifier threshold from recent BirdNET MQTT
settings.birdnetMqttAutoConfidenceHint: Uses BirdNET topic from Connection. Restart processor after changes.
settings.birdnetMqttBiasWindowHint: Priority comes from the ~24h BirdNET FIFO below. This only widens lookback from clip start when priors are empty.
settings.birdnetMqttBiasDeltaHint: For auto BirdNET species (manual overrides win).
settings.serviceScalesDesc: Current weight in the UI and mass on the visit card come from here. Configure the MQTT broker under Connections. Below, pick how the hub reads scale data: firmware MQTT topics or direct ESPHome Web API. The separate “Weight-change trigger” checkbox only decides whether a weight spike also starts a clip session.
settings.scalesSourceHint: Fields below change by source. Weight history, per-recording delta, and spike trigger work only in MQTT-backed modes.
settings.scalesHaEntityHint: e.g. sensor.smart_scale_weight — state must be numeric.
settings.scalesHaProcessorHint: The hub uses Home Assistant REST only for the current weight in the feeder card. Per-clip weight estimate, JSONL history, and "start recording on weight change" are implemented in the processor via MQTT: it must see every reading on a subscribed topic. For those features, choose MQTT as the source and set the same topic your integration publishes (often homeassistant/sensor/<id>/state). HA polling in the processor is not implemented yet.
settings.scalesUnitHint: How raw readings are shown in the feeder card and visit weight line.
settings.scalesMqttAlert: Firmware MQTT mode: by default the hub uses prefix `birdlense/scale` and derives weight, bird_present, and command automatically. The full topics below are only for overriding that standard layout.
settings.scalesMqttTopicHint: Leave empty for the standard {prefix}/weight. Payload: plain number or JSON value/weight/state.
settings.scalesMqttPrefixHint: Optional. If set and weight topic is empty, the hub uses {prefix}/weight and derives bird_present / tare as {prefix}/bird_present and {prefix}/command.
settings.scalesMqttBirdPresentTopicHint: If empty and prefix is set, the hub uses {prefix}/bird_present.
settings.scalesMqttCommandTopicHint: If empty and prefix is set, the hub uses {prefix}/command. Tare payload is `mqtt_tare_payload` in YAML, default `TARE`.
settings.scalesMqttTarePayloadHint: Published to the command topic when you tap Tare in the UI (default TARE).
settings.scalesHaAlert: Uses Home Assistant URL and token from Connections. The entity state must be numeric.
settings.scalesEspAlert: ESPHome mode: the hub polls the device over HTTP. This mode does not provide MQTT history, per-recording delta, or spike trigger.
settings.scalesEspWeightSensorIdHint: ESPHome YAML id, e.g. `weight_live_internal`. The hub reads GET /sensor/<id>.
settings.scalesEspBirdSensorIdHint: Optional. If set, the hub reads GET /binary_sensor/<id>.
settings.scalesEspTareButtonIdHint: Optional. If set, the tare button sends POST /button/<id>/press.
settings.scalesWeightEstimateHint: Store scale delta for the clip window (MQTT weight topic required). Only when the clip includes a visual detection or track (confirms presence on camera). Does not enable autostart. By default requires a spike between consecutive MQTT samples (see below).
settings.scalesEstimateRequireSpike: Require a weight spike between consecutive MQTT samples
settings.scalesEstimateRequireSpikeHint: Off: span (max−min) over the clip is enough. On (recommended): no estimate unless some adjacent step ≥ threshold — fewer false positives from drift; tared empty platform stays near zero.
settings.scalesMinDeltaKgEstimateHint: Ignore MQTT noise smaller than this when computing per-clip weight delta (stored as kg in config).
settings.scalesHistoryMaxLinesHint: Cap for the on-disk JSONL log of scale readings (MQTT mode only).
settings.scalesMotionTrigger: Start recording and recognition from weight (in addition to motion and MQTT events)
settings.scalesMotionTriggerHint: A weight spike on MQTT starts the same pipeline as an external MQTT event or motion (OpenCV) trigger. Other triggers stay active. Requires MQTT broker and weight topic. Not used when motion source is PIR.
settings.scalesMotionMinDeltaHint: Threshold in grams between two consecutive MQTT weight samples. Stored in config as kilograms.
settings.minTrackDurationHelp: ByteTrack tracks shorter than this are discarded. Shipped default **~0.25 s** (`processor.min_track_duration`) — keeps brief feeder visits while shedding flicker.
settings.confidenceThresholdsDesc: Classifier gates saving to DB; Telegram uses its own minimum so weak IDs can be archived without spam.
settings.confidenceDetectorHelp: Shipped default **24%** (`min_confidence_binary`, first-stage YOLO — BRG Bird/Rodent/Background bundle). After tracking, per-label floors apply (`min_confidence_binary_bird`, `min_confidence_binary_rodent`). Higher = fewer false boxes / empty clips.
settings.confidenceClassifierHelp: Shipped default **29%** (`min_confidence_to_process`). After voting × EU classifier; higher = fewer weak visits in DB.
settings.confidenceTelegramHelp: Shipped default **46%** (`min_confidence_to_notify`). Photo alerts at or above; can set above classifier to reduce chat noise.
settings.confidenceDatasetHelp: Shipped default **58%** (`dataset_min_confidence`) — which crops go to train.
settings.yoloSplitThresholdsDesc: Avoid one global squeeze: stricter **Bird** boxes, softer **Rodent** (mice, etc.). Empty field = use the shared detector threshold. Area cap skips species classifier on tiny Bird blobs (fewer false tits on mice).
settings.confidenceBinaryBirdHelp: Above the base threshold = fewer false birds at dusk. YOLO track uses min of thresholds; Bird boxes are filtered with this value.
settings.confidenceBinaryRodentHelp: Lower than Bird so small rodents are not dropped when the detection head fires on the rodent class (weights may still use an internal "squirrel" label).
settings.birdSkipClassifierArea: Max Bird area without species (fraction of frame)
settings.birdSkipClassifierAreaHelp: e.g. **0.018** = 1.8% of frame: smaller boxes skip the EU classifier and stay generic Bird (not “tit”). **0** or empty = off. Too high hurts small tits.
settings.lightGateDesc: If the frame is too dark or flat, YOLO is skipped to save CPU. Night/IR feeds often fail the contrast check — then tracks stay empty while external MQTT/BirdNET can still create species rows.
settings.lightGateEnabledHelp: Turn off to always run YOLO (more CPU, fixes “YOLO dead” on IR).
settings.lightGateMinBrightnessHelp: Below this, frames are skipped. Lower for dim scenes.
settings.lightGateMinContrastHelp: Below this, frames are skipped. IR often needs 8–12 instead of 20.
settings.falsePositiveGuardrailsDesc: Tighten the first-stage detector and generic fallback so feeder clutter is less likely to turn into fake birds.
settings.speciesConfidenceOverridesHint: Catalog name: threshold per line (e.g. **Rodent**: 0.28 for rodents). Lower for rare species.
settings.minBoxSizePxHint: Reject tiny detector boxes that are often feeder debris or motion noise.
settings.detectorScopeHint: First-stage labels (Bird, Rodent, …). In the **species catalog**, mammals are **Rodent** (EU classifier). Raw YOLO weights may still expose a rodent class as "Squirrel"; the hub normalizes it to Rodent.
settings.classifierFallbackBirdHint: Disable to reject weak bird-like tracks instead of saving a generic Bird label.
settings.includedBirdFamiliesHint: Comma- or newline-separated families used by species filters. Leave empty to keep all families.
settings.ebirdRegionalTopConfidenceIntro: eBird regional top: optionally use a lower classifier threshold for species in your region’s recent top list (same source as Migration). Manual lines above always win.
settings.ebirdRegionalTopAutoConfidence: Auto lower threshold for regional top species
settings.ebirdRegionalTopAutoConfidenceHint: Requires eBird API key and ebird.country/state. Restart processor after changes.
settings.ebirdRegionalTopConfidenceDeltaHint: e.g. 0.05 → threshold = max(floor, min_confidence_to_process − 0.05) for each top species not listed manually.
settings.ebirdRegionalTopConfidenceFloorHint: Auto threshold is never below this value (0.0–1.0).
settings.unknownConfidenceThresholdHelp: Detections below go to «Unknowns». Shipped default **0.48** (48%, `ui.unknown_confidence_threshold`).
settings.showTrackRegenControlsHelp: Heavy operation that re-runs detection on video. Off by default to avoid accidental overwrites.
settings.spectrogramDetailHelp: Pixels per second for the mel spectrogram image.
settings.generateSpectrogramAlwaysHelp: When off, a spectrogram is created only if a BirdNET MQTT event fell inside the recording window (saves CPU). When on, FFmpeg + librosa run after each finalized clip so the Audio tab always has an image when generation succeeds.
settings.saveDatasetCropsHelp: Best frames to data/dataset/train/<Species>. Export — Library → Recordings
settings.resolutionHint: Frame size for capture and recording. Affects quality and load.
settings.weatherHaAlert: Uses URL and token from Settings → Home Assistant. Here you only choose which weather.* entity to read (e.g. weather.home).
settings.xenoCantoApiKeyHint: For bird song playback on species pages. Get key at xeno-canto.org/account
settings.ebirdApiKeyHint: For regional comparison on Overview and species-mapping suggestions. Get at ebird.org/api/keygen
settings.ebirdProtocolHint: Usually `https`. Keep default unless your deployment explicitly requires another value.
settings.ebirdSpeciesMappingHint: eBird (Gray) → BirdLense (Grey). One pair per line: eBird name: BirdLense name
settings.ebirdMappingSuggestNoKey: Configure the eBird API key above to load regional top species.
settings.ebirdMappingSuggestEmpty: All regional top names already match the catalog (after your current mapping).
settings.zipFetchFailed: Failed to fetch coordinates. Please check the ZIP code.
settings.restartInfo: After saving, the processor restarts automatically to apply changes.
settings.pageDescription: Options are grouped by topic: general station, connections and video, capture and feeder, notifications, integrations, and recognition. Open the section you need and use the hints next to each field.
settings.deprecatedKeysAfterSave: Saved, but user_config still has deprecated keys ({{count}}): {{keys}}. Clean them up under System → Config audit.
settings.savedRestart: Settings saved. Processor will restart within ~60 seconds.
settings.saveError: Failed to save settings. Check your connection or try again.
settings.processorOpenvinoPathsManagedHint: OpenVINO paths are hidden in UI and managed by service mode/server config. In settings, users only select detector and classifier backends.

live.errorLoad: Could not load the live camera list.

live.streamGo2rtcProtocolAria: Go2RTC transport: auto (MSE→MJPEG), WebRTC, MSE, or MJPEG
live.overlaysHint: Yellow rectangles: OpenCV trigger candidate boxes (outside red masks). Green: YOLO while recording. Browser and detect streams may differ.
live.overlaysHowTo: 1) Gear icon on the camera tile. 2) Enable «Trigger boxes (OpenCV)». 3) Wait for motion — yellow boxes refresh about every 2s.
live.opencvNoContours: no contours (wind inside exclusion mask or low contrast)
live.masksHint: Red polygons: zones where OpenCV ignores motion. Edit: click frame → Close polygon → Save. Remove a mask via the list below or Clear layer and redraw.
live.detectorZonesHint: Blue polygons: YOLO detector interest zone for this camera. Detections outside the zone are rejected.
live.noMasksYet: No masks — click the frame to add a polygon.
live.overlayLoadFailed: Could not load overlay (API error). Refresh the page.
live.overlayNoProcessorData: Processor has not published live contours yet (opencv_live). Yellow outlines appear for motion outside red masks.

timeline.modeSwitcherAria: Choose timeline, favorites-only, or review mode

timeline.emptyVisits: No visits for this day with the current filters. Try another date, time-of-day filter, or clear the species filter.

storage.scanHint: Add disk recordings to DB (after restart)
storage.title: Storage Management
storage.purgeHint: Deletes matching videos from the database and removes their recording folders. Requires admin unlock when a settings password is set.
storage.purgeSkipsFavorites: Recordings marked favorite are skipped when «Protect favorites» is enabled in System → Retention (same as automatic retention).
storage.purgeConfirmRange: Delete all recordings from {{start}} through {{end}} (inclusive)? This cannot be undone.
storage.purgeConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete all recordings on or before {{date}}? This action cannot be undone.
storage.regenerateSpectrogramsHint: Generate spectrograms for old videos that don't have them (optional, for audio/visualization)
storage.trackRegenDisabledHint: Track regeneration is hidden. Turn on «Show track regeneration in Library» in Settings → Processor.
storage.regenerateTracksPeriodHelp: Only videos within this period will be processed.
storage.archiveRangeSummary: Archive on disk: {{start}} - {{end}} (calendar span {{spanDays}} days, {{recordedDays}} days with files, {{files}} files, {{size}}). The “All time” preset uses exactly this span.
storage.archiveRangeUnavailable: No archive range detected on disk yet. The “All time” preset becomes available after recordings appear.
storage.regenerateTracksEffectiveParams: Active settings: frame step {{step}}, {{px}} px, strategy {{strategy}}, timeout {{timeout}} s
storage.regenerateTracksSpeciesFilterActive: Species filter: {{count}} selected (only videos with those detections)
storage.regenerateTracksFullClassScope: Model classes: full scope (processor.regional_species ignored for this job)
storage.trackRegenSpeciesHint: List is built from tracks on videos (not visits only). Pick a species that already has rows on recordings: only those videos enter the queue. The model runs on the whole file; only selected species that actually get a new detection in this run are replaced (other selected species on that same file are not wiped). Unrelated species on the file are untouched.
storage.trackRegenSpeciesPeriodNote: With a species filter, the period for this button is the full span from storage stats (first–last day with files), not the narrow period above — so rare clips are not skipped.
storage.trackRegenSpeciesPeriodNoStats: Species filter is on, but storage stats are not loaded — the date range above is used. Widen it (e.g. «All») if the queue stays empty.
storage.strictQualityExport: Strict quality: abort if any class is below min size or data fails gates
storage.retroExportRebuildHint: Delete crops for period and re-extract only crops (guaranteed no full-frame)
storage.retroExportHint: Extract frames from all video detections into dataset (for corrected species)
storage.retroExportSuccessWithNoBbox: Saved {{saved}}, skipped {{skipped}} ({{skipped_no_bbox}} no bbox — full frame skipped)
storage.retroExportRebuildConfirm: Rebuild dataset for period? All crops for selected dates will be deleted and only crops re-extracted from videos.
storage.cleanDatasetHint: Remove suspected full-frame (by size and aspect ratio) and/or orphaned files
storage.cleanDatasetConfirm: Remove suspected full-frame from dataset? Files >800×600 with 16:9/4:3 aspect will be deleted.
storage.heavyOpsIntro: The “all time” range is safe, but runtime depends on archive size. The heaviest operations are:
storage.heavyOpsSpectrograms: Regenerate spectrograms: heavy video/audio pass; not needed for YOLO crop export.
storage.heavyOpsTracks: Regenerate tracks: the heaviest option because it walks video frames again.
storage.heavyOpsDataset: Dataset export/retro-export: reads the archive and builds a ZIP; best run after import and corrections, not during peak recording time.
storage.cleanOrphanedVisitsHint: Removes orphaned visits and syncs data. Fixes incorrect counts in calendars and species summaries after corrections.
storage.cleanOrphanedVisitsConfirm: Remove orphaned visits and sync species_id? This will fix counts in calendars and species views.
storage.mergeSpeciesConfirm: Merge duplicate species (e.g. Garrulus glandarius (Eurasian Jay) → Eurasian Jay)? This updates the database.
storage.mergeSpeciesSuccess: Merged {{count}} duplicate species into canonical names
storage.dbBackupRestoreHint: Download a backup before major updates. Restore replaces the current DB and creates a pre-restore backup on the server.
storage.dbRestoreConfirm: Replace the current database with "{{name}}"? A pre-restore backup will be saved on the server first.
storage.nasMirrorIntro: After each saved recording, the processor uploads a copy of the session folder to an SFTP server (e.g. Synology). Database paths stay local; the hub still plays video from local disk. Configure host, user, and password here — same as other hub secrets (masked in the API).
storage.nasMirrorRemoteBaseHint: Remote directory; session folders are created under it with the same YYYY/MM/DD/HHMMSS layout as on the hub.
storage.nasMirrorKeyPathHint: Path inside the container (e.g. mounted key). If empty, SFTP password authentication uses the password field above.
storage.nasMirrorKnownHostsHint: When strict checking is on, this file is loaded if set; otherwise the image default host keys are used.
storage.nasMirrorDeleteLocal: Delete local session after successful upload
storage.nasMirrorDeleteLocalWarn: Dangerous: the hub will no longer play these files until you re-import from NAS or restore copies. Intended only for offload setups that understand the trade-off.
storage.nasMirrorSftpPasswordHint: Leave blank to keep the current saved password. Enter a new value to replace it.
storage.nasMirrorKeyPassphraseHint: Only if the private key file is encrypted. Leave blank to keep the current passphrase.
storage.nasMirrorProcessorRestartRequested: Processor restart was requested so the mirror settings apply on the next processor cycle.
storage.nasMirrorEnvOverrideHint: Optional: non-empty BIRDLENSE_RECORDINGS_MIRROR_SFTP_PASSWORD / …_KEY_PASSPHRASE in app/.env override these values in memory only (see CONFIGURATION.md).
storage.nasMirrorTestOk: SFTP connection OK; remote directory is available.

migrationCalendar.periodModeDatesTooltip: Limit the table to a custom date range (inclusive).
migrationCalendar.catalogMenuHintObserved: Only species with visits in the selected period.
migrationCalendar.catalogMenuHintDataset: Species present in the local dataset (train/ folders, etc.).
migrationCalendar.catalogMenuHintFullEu: Full EU allowlist — the grid may show zeros for many rows.

details.title: Activity Statistics
details.content: Track unique bird species visits, total detections, and last hour activity. The system counts both video and audio detections, distinguishing between different species using computer vision and audio analysis.

details.title: Visit Metrics
details.content: Monitor average visit duration and identify the busiest hour of bird activity. The system considers a continuous period of detections as a single visit, helping understand bird feeding patterns.

details.title: Audio/Video Ratio
details.content: Shows the proportion of birds detected through audio versus video. A ratio less than 1 means more video detections, while greater than 1 indicates more audio detections. This helps evaluate detector performance.

details.title: Weather Information

details.title: Daily Activity Pattern
details.content: A 24-hour circular visualization showing when different species visit the feeder. The chart uses color-coding to distinguish between species, with the length of each segment indicating the number of detections.

details.title: Date Selection
details.content: Use the date picker to view historical data for any specific day. This allows you to track patterns over time and compare activity levels across different dates.

details.title: Visit Metrics
details.content: Monitor average visit duration and identify the busiest hour of bird activity. The system considers a continuous period of detections as a single visit, helping understand bird feeding patterns.

details.title: Audio/Video Ratio
details.content: Shows the proportion of birds detected through audio versus video. A ratio less than 1 means more video detections, while greater than 1 indicates more audio detections. This helps evaluate detector performance.

details.title: Weather Information
details.content: Current weather conditions that may affect bird activity, including temperature, cloud cover, humidity, and wind speed. Weather data is automatically updated and stored with each detection.

details.title: Daily Activity Pattern
details.content: A 24-hour circular visualization showing when different species visit the feeder. The chart uses color-coding to distinguish between species, with the length of each segment indicating the number of detections.

details.title: Date Selection
details.content: Use the date picker to view historical data for any specific day. This allows you to track patterns over time and compare activity levels across different dates.

details.title: What the calendar means
details.content: The calendar is built from real files under data/recordings, so highlighted days mean recordings exist on disk for that date.

details.title: Why this matters
details.content: This helps separate archive problems from detection problems. If a day is highlighted here but Overview or Timeline is empty, recordings exist but detections or visits are missing.

details.title: What you can do here
details.content: Browse the archive, scan/import from disk, export datasets, backups, and storage overview—all under the Data menu item.

details.title: How this relates to Service
details.content: Service is for monitoring, processor logs, and deep diagnostics. File-based archive work is concentrated here.

details.title: About maintenance
details.content: Heavy tasks (import, rebuild, cleanup) are easier when you already know which days exist in the archive; the calendar reflects files on disk.

details.title: Visit Controls
details.content:
Filter and navigate visits using:

- Species dropdown to filter by specific bird types
- Summary statistics showing unique species count, total visits, and total duration

details.title: Day navigation
details.content: Chevrons next to the date jump to the nearest day that has files in your recordings archive on disk (empty days are skipped). Choosing a date in the picker still opens that exact day.

details.title: Visit Information
details.content:
Each visit card displays:
- Bird species with image and name
- Number of birds seen simultaneously (shown with person icon)
- Visit duration in seconds (shown with clock icon)
- Temperature during the visit (shown with thermometer icon)
- Expandable view for detailed detection timeline

details.title: Detection Types
details.content:
Within each visit, detections are shown with:
- Video detections (camera icon) - Visual confirmation of birds
- Audio detections (microphone icon) - Bird calls and songs
- Confidence percentage for each detection
- Precise timestamp for every observation
- Duration in seconds for each detection

details.title: Visual Timeline
details.content:
The vertical timeline shows:
- Chronological sequence of visits with time markers
- Connected dots indicating continuous monitoring
- Expandable/collapsible visit details
- Clear separation between different visits

details.title: Detection Confidence
details.content:
Each detection shows confidence levels:
- Video detections typically show 95-100% confidence
- Audio detections may have varying confidence levels
- Green indicators for high confidence (100%)
- Blue indicators for good confidence (95% and above)

details.title: Weather Context
details.content: Temperature data is recorded for each visit to help correlate bird activity with weather conditions. This helps identify patterns in bird behavior related to environmental factors.

details.content: Species, duration, temperature. Expand for detections over time. Open a clip for details.
